# Preface: making room before building structure

"Before writing about Parole—what it is, how it was built, and what it aims to do—I need to set something down. Not its content, but its weight.
After days of intersecting ideas, revisions, doubts about authorship, fear that AI might overshadow judgment, and fear of seeming like a fraud, what remains is clarity.
And clarity needs room.

Writing, like programming, is a technical act.
It is also an emotional one.
If we fail to acknowledge that, the report becomes an extension of what we left unsaid.

This document therefore begins with what will not be in it: what has already been said, considered, and set down. What now allows me to write from language rather than anxiety."

*By GPT; English translation of the original preface.*
